description: Minimum capabilities for the Reachy Mini mobile client: OS detection + daemon fetch. The robot is reached strictly by LAN IP (no mDNS). The http scope's robot entry is a bare 'http://*:8000/*' ON PURPOSE: URLPattern canonicalizes IPv4-looking hostname patterns (e.g. '192.168.*.*' parses as '192.0.0.168*.*'), so per-subnet wildcards silently never match and every app-to-robot request gets denied. Port 8000 plain-HTTP is robot-daemon-only traffic.
